name: data-table
useFor: Use for a list of records people manage (mailboxes, agents and lines, webhook subscriptions): pass columns (id, header, an accessor for sorting and filtering, a cell renderer), data and getRowId. Turn on selectable for bulk actions and put those actions in toolbar; set pageSize and pageSizes for long lists. For a short fixed list with no sorting or paging, use Table on its own. Keep row actions as ghost icon buttons in the last column.
constraints: A border around the whole table instead of the three panels
Animating rows when sorting or paging
More than one purple pill in the toolbar
source: Figma 427:2715: Email (Mailboxes table and its pagination bar), iMessage (Agents and lines)
title: Data Table
description: The console's table with a filter field, sortable heads, row checkboxes, a Columns menu and the lilac pagination bar.
